title: Mario keeps the beings out of his debrief to keep his PRP clearance

tellings.quote: Had I said that I saw these beings,

plain: Air Force veteran Mario Woods says that in November 1977, after a strange night in the nuclear missile field at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he left out of his official debriefing that he had seen beings. He says he did it to keep his PRP clearance, the Air Force screening that decides who may work near nuclear weapons. If true, it would mean what really happened that night never made it into the record.
